light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Same place, same framing, same clothes. On the workbench: a thick steel plate, the pipe ring, a small blowtorch, a bucket of dry sand, a hand plane and a wooden stake in the vice. He stands at the bench. In work shots he looks down at what his hands are doing with a calm concentrated working expression, mouth closed, not looking at the camera; he looks at the camera only when he is talking to it.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he holds the disc with its shank toward the camera after hammering, the weld intact, nodding. He is still wearing the navy-blue button-up work shirt with the sleeves rolled up, exactly as in the first image. In work shots he looks down at what his hands are doing with a calm concentrated working expression, mouth closed, not looking at the camera; he looks at the camera only when he is talking to it.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he holds the finished disc with the shank up to the light, the weld a neat even bead, looking at it with a pleased face. He is still wearing the navy-blue button-up work shirt with the sleeves rolled up, exactly as in the first image. In work shots he looks down at what his hands are doing with a calm concentrated working expression, mouth closed, not looking at the camera; he looks at the camera only when he is talking to it.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he lifts the cup with the stake hanging inside it by friction, smiling at the camera. He is still wearing the navy-blue button-up work shirt with the sleeves rolled up, exactly as in the first image. In work shots he looks down at what his hands are doing with a calm concentrated working expression, mouth closed, not looking at the camera; he looks at the camera only when he is talking to it.

Same photo, same place, same framing, a few seconds later: he holds the planed stake head up to the light, four bright chamfers visible on its corners, looking at it. He is still wearing the navy-blue button-up work shirt with the sleeves rolled up, exactly as in the first image. In work shots he looks down at what his hands are doing with a calm concentrated working expression, mouth closed, not looking at the camera; he looks at the camera only when he is talking to it.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the hands and materials only, same place and same light as the first input image, the face is not in the frame (ignore the last input image): close view of a wooden stake head with four planed chamfers being slid into a steel pipe ring, a snug fit.
Same extreme close-up, same framing, same light, a few seconds later: the same head fully seated, a small even gap around it.

clips.text: La prueba del martillazo: le doy unos golpes fuertes a la soldadura. Si suena limpio y no salta nada, sirve.
clips.action: he hits the finished weld hard several times with a hammer and listens, then shows it to the camera.

clips.text: Un cordón parejo, sin poros. Y no lo pulo: lo dejo como salió, que cuanto más grueso, mejor.
clips.action: he lifts the helmet and chips slag off the finished weld with a small hammer, looking closely.

clips.text: Y pruebo el encaje en seco. Entra justo, con un poco de juego. La estaca cuelga sola, sin caerse.
clips.action: he presses the finished cup onto a chamfered stake on the bench and wiggles it to test the fit.

clips.text: Y ahora el truco de las estacas: le biselo las cuatro esquinas de la cabeza, a cuarenta y cinco grados.
clips.action: he clamps a wooden stake in the vice and planes its four corners with a hand plane at forty-five degrees, wood shavings curling.

clips.d1: close view of a wooden stake head with four planed chamfers being slid into a steel pipe ring, a snug fit
clips.d2: the same head fully seated, a small even gap around it
clips.text: Así entra derecha, sin trabarse, y la madera no se abre, porque el caño la abraza de todos lados.
